//: What the demo deliberately does not do, one line of reason each. Read by contract.test.mjs: a host->client message type the demo never builds, or an /api route the phone calls that the demo answers with its fall-through 404, must be listed here. An entry the demo now handles, or that no longer exists, fails as stale.

messages.updates.status: not reachable in demo: the demo host has no install to check, and updates.get/check/apply are refused in words by the handler table
messages.updates.result: not reachable in demo: updates.apply is refused in words, so no apply ever completes
messages.host.restarting: not reachable in demo: the demo host lives in the page and never restarts, so there is no SIGTERM to announce
messages.billing.status: not reachable in demo: a demo host has no billing profile to probe, so the phone reads its absence as unknown (billing.get is answered with nothing)
messages.authRequired: not reachable in demo: there is no password gate, so no socket is ever refused for a missing token
messages.build.options: not reachable in demo: builds are tier B (refused); build.list answers with no builds to take options for
messages.build.output: not reachable in demo: builds are refused, so no build ever streams output
messages.build.run: not reachable in demo: builds are refused, so no run ever changes state
messages.capture.output: not reachable in demo: verified capture is refused, so nothing streams
messages.capture.run: not reachable in demo: verified capture is refused, so no run ever changes state
messages.delivery.settled: not reachable in demo: no delivery is ever left open to settle later (the seeded delivery.list is static)
messages.halt.state: not reachable in demo: host.halt is tier B (refused) — there are no AI processes to stop, so the latch never changes
messages.error: the demo answers every refusal with its receipt or a toast, never the generic error frame
messages.fanout.run: not reachable in demo: fan-out is refused (tier B); fanout.list answers empty
messages.input.settled: not reachable in demo: input.settle is tier B, every delivery is confirmed at once so nothing needs settling
messages.launch.opened: not reachable in demo: launches are never parked (launch.run refused), so no gate ever opens
messages.onboard.progress: not reachable in demo: the first-app job is refused over HTTP, so no job ever progresses
messages.plugin.actionResult: not reachable in demo: no plugins installed, plugin.action is refused
messages.plugin.error: not reachable in demo: no plugins installed, plugin.set/enable are refused
messages.pull.config: gap: pull.get is refused (tier B), so the auto-pull rule is never sent
messages.pull.new: gap: the demo's pull queue is seeded only; nothing new is detected on a scenario desktop
messages.sent.new: gap: the sent log is answered on request (sent.get) but not appended live
messages.session.closecheck: not reachable in demo: the close check reads git, which the demo does not have (refused in words)
messages.session.focus: gap: the demo navigates by the create's op.ack sessionId and never sends a separate focus
messages.session.searchResults: not reachable in demo: session.search reads real conversation logs (refused in words)
messages.stream.ended: not reachable in demo: stream.open is refused (stream.refused), so no stream is ever open to end
messages.stream.opened: not reachable in demo: stream.open is refused in words with stream.refused — there is no desktop to stream
messages.stream.status: not reachable in demo: stream.open is refused, so no stream is ever open to report on
